caption: The drawing depicts a tall grandfather clock with a wooden case, primarily brown in color, featuring intricate panel designs and moldings. The clock has a rectangular lower section with a molded base and feet. Above this, the central elongated section includes a tall door with a carved fan motif near the top and decorative wood grain patterns. At the top, the clock face is housed in an arched compartment with a rounded pediment and three finials. The clock face itself is circular and gilded, with black Roman numerals on a gold background, and includes ornate detailing and smaller decorative elements. The upper side panels of the clock have what appear to be glass or dark-colored sections. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, leaving focus solely on the grandfather clock.
title: Clock Case
